plausibility_notes: Justin becomes the strongest accusation: unlike Al's offered sealed favor, he admits opening a miniature beside the glass and handling that glass. This joins the laboratory route to a particular guest.
A provisional accusation of Justin is justified at this final release, but it is not conclusive: common labels and shared sideboard access leave Brie and other handlers credible alternatives.
No witness places Justin at forced storage entry or identifies the contaminated favor or fragment as his. His denial about map sleeve lacks an independently released map-sleeve search result.
Final speeches supply many corroborating records as character claims; their documents are not independently displayed. No continuous alibis are falsely asserted.
